en: For security, after several failed attempts your account is locked for a few minutes. Wait about 5 minutes and try again, or reset your password if you don't remember it.
For your security, the account locks for a few minutes after several failed attempts. Wait about 5 minutes and try again, or reset your password if you can't remember it.
Too many failed attempts lock the account for a few minutes to protect it. Try again in about 5 minutes, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
Your account is temporarily locked because of several failed attempts. It unlocks on its own in about 5 minutes; if you don't remember the password, you can reset it.
This is a security measure: after several wrong attempts, the account locks for a few minutes. Wait around 5 minutes before trying again, or reset your password if you're not sure of it.
es: Por seguridad, después de varios intentos fallidos tu cuenta se bloquea durante unos minutos. Espera unos 5 minutos e inténtalo de nuevo, o restablece tu contraseña si no la recuerdas.

Demasiados intentos fallidos bloquean la cuenta unos minutos para protegerla. Vuelve a intentarlo en unos 5 minutos, o restablece tu contraseña si la olvidaste.
Tu cuenta está bloqueada temporalmente por varios intentos fallidos. Se desbloquea sola en unos 5 minutos; si no recuerdas la contraseña, puedes restablecerla.
